implementation: Trusted transitive dependencies restrict implicit and explicit reads, count filters, sorting, owned details and snapshots.
Stable field identity protects renamed columns and same-named parent/detail fields.
Resource generation and target policy shared locks are held through authorization and data projection; READ_COMMITTED does not promise a repeatable dataset snapshot.
Snapshot provenance binds the actually installed calculation revision and checksum; caller-supplied retry revisions cannot weaken it.
Removed formulas do not remove historical snapshot dependencies. Missing or inconsistent provenance fails closed.

Ordinary snapshots retain the previous binary-compatible JSON; positive calculation revisions use an internal versioned envelope. Fractional contract/revision numbers are rejected rather than truncated.
testedBoundaries: Hidden and masked parent/detail sources, transitive results and untaken conditional branches.
Calculated outputs remain non-writable; authorized masked targets retain their mask.
Exact historical revision/checksum, absent metadata, future provenance and cross-tenant/model operations rejected.
Single physical connection for parent/detail/version reads; actual PostgreSQL/MySQL activation waits for the admitted reader.
Offline and stale generation reads rejected before opening the target datasource.
Formula removal and physical column renaming; snapshot retry revisions 0,1,2,50 cannot bypass historical dependencies.
